title: How Worry Chokes God's Promises For Your Life
titleZh: 憂慮如何扼殺神對你生命的應許
summaryZh: 憂慮與分心會如同荊棘般扼殺神在我們生命中的應許，我們必須專一尋求神的旨意。
lines: Verse 18, these are the ones sown among thorns.
第十八節，還有那撒在荊棘裡的。
They are the ones who hear the word, and the cares of this world, the deceitfulness of riches, and the desires for other things enter in and choke the word.
就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了。
You and I with our thoughts, our attitudes, our appetites have the capacity to put a stranglehold on the promise that God has given.
你和我的思想、態度與慾望，有能力扼殺神所賜下的應許。
He talks here about giving ourselves for weeds to grow.
祂在這裡談到我們容讓雜草生長。
Anybody, anybody a gardener in here?
這裡有任何人是園丁嗎？
I'm not, my wife is, although we just are in the process of doing a wonderful garden, and I'm cheering her on.
我不是，我太太才是，雖然我們現在正打造一個很棒的花園，而我負責為她加油打氣。
And as soon as my hot peppers are in full bloom, I will help her harvest.
只要我的辣椒一盛開，我就會幫她採收。
And we have a little orchard of about 30 trees, and I'm going to pick the apples too.
我們還有一個大約有三十棵樹的小果園，我也會負責摘蘋果。
That's my part, "Go, Penny, give me an apple," fill it in.
那就是我的部分，「上啊，潘妮，給我一顆蘋果，」幫我填滿空缺。
Why do weeds grow bigger, faster, stronger than the plant you want to grow?
為什麼雜草總是比你想要種植的植物長得更大、更快、更強壯？
It's a weird thing, it happened because of the Fall.
這是一件怪事，這一切都是因為人類墮落而發生的。
Here He says weeds grow and choke the word of the Lord.
在這裡祂說雜草會生長，並把主的話語擠住。
The promise of your life can actually be choked, strangled by the deceitfulness of riches, the cares of this world, and the desire for other things.
你生命的應許實際上可能會被錢財的迷惑、世上的思慮和別樣的私慾所擠住、扼殺。
Let me break down those three things for you.
讓我為你們詳細解說這三件事。
That word for cares actually comes from two words.
思慮這個詞其實源自兩個字。
Number one is divided, and number two is mind.
第一個是分裂，第二個是心思。
Cares of this world is the divided mind.
世上的思慮就是分裂的心思。
A lot of people experience—not you, it's them, other folks—a lot of people experience anxiety, confusion, and stress because their mind is divided.
許多人經歷到——不是你們，是他們，其他人——許多人經歷到焦慮、混亂和壓力，因為他們的心思是分裂的。
Jesus and all these other options.
耶穌以及所有這些其他的選擇。
Years ago, I remember hearing a story, read a story actually in a book about this gentleman.
多年前，我記得聽過一個故事，其實是在一本書裡讀到關於這位男士的故事。
He was a great athlete and loved competition, loved sports of all kinds.
他是一位偉大的運動員，熱愛競爭，熱愛各種運動。
And he ended up in a horrible accident, lost an arm.
後來他遭遇了一場可怕的意外，失去了一隻手臂。
And he spent considerable time after that trying to find some kind of a sport that he could be involved in with only one arm.
在那之後，他花了相當長的時間試圖尋找某種只有一隻手臂也能參與的運動。
And he ended up for some reason picking up the sport called handball.
不知為何，他最後選擇了這項名叫手球的運動。
Give me a racket, I'd rather hit the ball with a racket.
給我一支球拍吧，我寧願用球拍擊球。
It's this hard little ball, almost as hard as a golf ball, that you hit off your hand that has a thin layer of leather over each hand.
那是一種堅硬的小球，幾乎和高爾夫球一樣硬，你要雙手各戴著一層薄薄的皮手套去擊球。
You hit it off the wall as in racquetball, and it's a very intense and competitive sport.
你就像打壁球一樣把它打向牆壁，這是一項非常激烈且具競爭性的運動。
So he picked up this particular sport called handball, and he became so good over time he became the club champion.
所以他開始接觸這項名叫手球的特定運動，隨著時間過去，他變得非常厲害，成為了俱樂部冠軍。
And then his club entered him in the state championship, and he competed on a statewide level.
然後他的俱樂部為他報名了州冠軍賽，他在全州級別的比賽中競爭。
And he ended up taking first place in his state for handball.
最終他在全州手球比賽中獲得了第一名。
Following his championship match, a newspaper writer wanted to interview him.
在他的冠軍賽之後，一位報社記者想採訪他。
So he interviewed him, and one of his questions he says, "How is it that a man with only one hand can defeat all your opponents that play with two hands?"
於是記者採訪了他，他其中一個問題問道：「一個只有一隻手的人，怎麼能擊敗所有用兩隻手打球的對手呢？」
And the newspaper guy said, "What do you mean, options?"
那位記者說：「什麼意思，選擇？」
He said, "When the ball comes off the wall, my opponent has to decide what hand to use."
他說：「當球從牆上彈回來時，我的對手必須決定要用哪隻手。」
"I only had one option, the decision had been made."
「我只有一個選擇，決定早就做好了。」
Too many Christians have too many options, and we invite confusion.
太多基督徒有太多的選擇，於是我們招致了混亂。
When you invite confusion, you actually create the atmosphere for anxiety, worry, all of those things.
當你招致混亂時，你實際上就製造了讓焦慮、憂慮和所有這類事情滋生的氛圍。
It doesn't mean we would never face it otherwise, it's just we always have the upper hand when we only have one option.
這並不意味著如果是別種情況我們就永遠不會面對它，只是當我們只有一個選擇時，我們總是能佔上風。
When our only option is, "I am hungry for the will of God."
當我們唯一的選擇是：「我飢渴慕義地尋求神的旨意。」
"I don't care what it tastes like in the moment, it's what I'm hungry for, it's what I want."
「我不在乎它此刻嚐起來是什麼味道，這就是我所渴慕的，這就是我想要的。」
Jesus said, "My food is to do the will of Him who sent me."
耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意。」
The will of God sometimes is very sour or bitter to the taste, but it's always pleasant to the stomach.
神的旨意有時嚐起來很酸或很苦，但對胃來說總是舒適的。
The will of man is always sweet to the taste, but it turns sour in the stomach.
人的旨意嚐起來總是甜的，但在胃裡卻會變酸。
And there's something about the will of God that nourishes and strengthens.
神的旨意中有一種能帶來滋養和力量的特質。
So here we have this issue of the cares of life.
所以在這裡我們看到了世上思慮的問題。
So think about it this way, every moment that you and I spend in worry and anxiety, we are actually feeding the beast that strangles the promise over our destiny.
所以這樣想吧，你和我在憂慮和焦慮中所度過的每一刻，我們其實都在餵養那隻扼殺我們命定應許的野獸。
Every moment that I spend in worry and anxiety, I'm actually fueling, I'm feeding the beast that is working to put a stranglehold over my destiny, over the promises of my life.
我在憂慮和焦慮中所度過的每一刻，我實際上都在助長、在餵養那隻正企圖扼殺我命定、扼殺我生命應許的野獸。
The devil cannot read our thoughts.
魔鬼無法讀透我們的思想。
He cannot read your thoughts, but he can read the thoughts he suggests.
牠無法讀透你的思想，但牠能讀懂牠所暗示的那些思想。
And I think he can sometimes tell when one of his suggestions, called fiery darts, has made it past the shield of faith, because it affects our countenance.
而且我認為，有時牠能看出牠那被稱為『火箭』的暗示何時穿透了信心的盾牌，因為那會影響我們的面容。
And whenever that has happened, there is an agreement.
而每當這種情況發生時，就產生了一種同意。
And the enemy is always empowered by our agreement.
仇敵總是藉由我們的同意而獲得能力。
Agreeing with the enemy empowers him to kill, steal, destroy.
與仇敵同意，就賦予了牠殺害、偷竊、毀壞的能力。
I don't want to over-exaggerate the devil's role, but I do want to make us alert in the assignment.
我不想過度誇大魔鬼的角色，但我確實希望我們在任務中保持警醒。
Because I believe so much, I've talked about this subject from different angles a lot in the last year.
因為我深信不疑，過去一年裡我從不同角度談論過很多次這個主題。
I feel like we're coming into a season of unusual breakthrough, but it requires the fulfillment of promise.
我覺得我們正在進入一個非比尋常的突破季節，但這需要應許的成就。
How many of you have a whole bunch of promises over your life that are not yet fulfilled?
你們當中有多少人，生命中有一大堆尚未成就的應許？
So here we have the cares of this world.
所以在這裡我們看到了世上的思慮。
